name: fbiommu-t5
purpose: T5 first IOVA scan: kern.n2fbiommutest=1, kern.n2fbiommu=2 + kern.n2fbhw=2 (single-layer frames read scattered >4 GiB surfaces through IOVAs) for 180 s from t=60, kern.n2fbhwtest=6 at t=70 (colour test through the IOMMU: PHOTO during the hold); then iommu 0, hw 0; pool untouched
undo: guest-fbhwctl-undo.sh (payload-fbiommu-undo): removes job + binary + config; then reinstall payload-fbhwmode3 on q10jgb to get back the delivered state
config: modes=2 iommu=2 probe=1 iotest=1 hwtest=6 period=180 delay=60 final=0
needs: a kernel with 0401+0403 WITHOUT 0402: q10jgi (combined, recommended; t5/t6 need it) or q10jfnis (c7132034, t1-t4)
phone.py reset fastboot by the caller first; run with iommu-20261113b/phone/run_fbiommu_step.sh
